items.item: 18 core rows and within-device pair keys
input restore and controlled buffer lifetimes
HIP Graph capture and cross-device route/event smoke

b4_smoke_plan.phase: B4 before formal timing; no eager/host-staging fallback
b4_smoke_plan.activation: capture all four arms on both GPUs; reset gates outside every replay; check every output, per-gate alias, invalidation and shared-up preservation
b4_smoke_plan.communication: all four B2 requests, including both 1.5MiB directions; 50 independent sources/destinations; vary source payloads outside each replay to detect stale copies
b4_smoke_plan.chain: producer/copy/consumer quartet and GPU1 start/end fences; no cross-device Event subtraction
b4_smoke_plan.event_proof: destination-stream consumer guard must be causally after copy and before end Event; retain route/dependency trace; a host-synchronized output check alone is insufficient
b4_smoke_plan.identity: actual loaded Torch/HIP/FlagScale implementation, both UUIDs, strides/aliases, input fingerprints and peer route
b4_smoke_plan.failure: stop the affected whole round group, preserve artifacts, no timing labels; do not silently drop an arm or replace Graph with eager
